title: Orthogonal evidence can raise root-cut robustness more than same-family replication

setup.orthogonal_candidate: Lu et al. 2016, PMID 27472703, beta-catenin protein/localization plus pathway perturbation

interpretation: Two datasets that reuse one projection family are context replications but remain vulnerable to failure of that shared projection root. A measurement family that does not reuse the projection definition can improve structural evidence robustness.
invariants: Orthogonal Measurement Can Be Higher Information Gain Than Same-Axis Replication
Evidence Topology Is Part Of Validation Design
boundary: The 1->2 root-cut result is a structural dependency calculation, not a biological effect-size or truth-confidence score. Lu 2016 supplies source-bound orthogonal compatibility, not validation of a universal R latent state.
